phrase.zh: 形状之间，也可以有节奏。
phrase.en: There can be rhythm between shapes.

visual.zh: 康定斯基的生成肖像被圆、线与色块环绕，将抽象绘画的节奏转成一场视觉对话。它并非《构成第八号》的复制，也不使用某套统一的颜色含义词典。
visual.en: A generated Kandinsky portrait is surrounded by circles, lines and colors in a visual dialogue. It is not a copy of Composition 8 or an application of a universal color dictionary.

background.zh: 古根海姆博物馆将《构成第八号》定年为 1923 年 7 月。其教学资料通过几何形与空间关系介绍这件作品。抽象绘画可以让观看者关注形状、方向与节奏本身，而不必把每个形状猜成一件现实物品。
background.en: The Guggenheim dates Composition 8 to July 1923 and discusses it through geometry and spatial relationships. Abstract painting can invite attention to shape, direction and rhythm themselves, without requiring every form to stand for a recognizable object.
